canonical_node.axiom: The chi-field Lagrangian density, when varied, yields the equations of motion and conserved quantities that define the theoretical framework.
definitions: chi-field: a scalar field with Lagrangian density leading to a nonlinear Klein-Gordon equation with cubic self-interaction.
J_grace: a source term in the chi-field equation, with unresolved dimensional issues.
G_eff: effective gravitational constant modified by chi-field coupling, G_eff = G / (1 + chi).
derivation: Section 1: Write chi-field action in flat and curved spacetime.
Section 2: Apply Euler-Lagrange to obtain chi + mchi + chi = J_grace.
Section 3: Show naive product form fails dimensional analysis; chi-field Lagrangian passes.
Section 4: Compute propagator residue = +1, indicating no ghost modes.
Section 5: Take non-relativistic limit to obtain Gross-Pitaevskii equation.
Section 6: Derive Noether currents and stress-energy tensor.
Section 7: Couple to gravity to get modified Einstein equations with G_eff.
Section 8: Derive grace source term J_grace, noting open dimensional issue.
Section 9: Analyze stability at chi=0 for m>0, >0.
Section 10: Provide honest status report of derived vs asserted vs open.
